message.content: Proposed 2 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: 统一英文问卷表达（Q1 题干补全为 “with the service”，与 Q2 平行；选项格式本就一致、标签不动），并按题号同步方法说明中的 5 级量表描述。

hunks.newText: Q1. How satisfied are you with the service?

hunks.oldText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: We used a five-level scale for each item. Question 1 (Q1) measured satisfaction with the service (1 = Very dissatisfied, 2 = Dissatisfied, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Satisfied, 5 = Very satisfied), and Question 2 (Q2) measured willingness to recommend the service (1 = Definitely no, 2 = Probably no, 3 = Unsure, 4 = Probably yes, 5 = Definitely yes).
